items.name: Provinispettacolo — Musica

evidence.excerpt: Scopri come candidarti gratuitamente per lavorare come cantante, musicista e altre figure artistiche legate al mondo della musica!
The site accepts casting/audition notices submitted by outside parties and says it attempts to verify them, while warning that not all notices are in good faith.
The 8 October 2026 Opera e Lirica listing names soprano, mezzo-soprano, tenor, baritone and bass roles.

items.reason: Stable music-category page with explicit singer coverage and a current classical-vocal audition lead. The publisher clearly identifies itself as a third-party casting portal and discloses verification limitations.
limitations: Not an official organizer or institution; use only as a discovery source.
Individual notices must be checked against the original organizer before opportunity publication.
The 17 November 2026 audition and 13 November deadline remain third-party-only; the official website confirms use of the email address for a different vacancy, not this audition.

organizer_crosscheck.excerpt: The official Opera e Lirica website lists candidatureopera@gmail.com for a separate Social Media Content Creator vacancy.
organizer_crosscheck.finding: The contact address is corroborated on the organizer's official site, but the specific 17 November 2026 singer audition is not published there.

items.name: Teatro Lirico Sperimentale di Spoleto — 81st International Singing Competition

evidence.excerpt: The official Bandi e avvisi page links directly to CONCORSO DI CANTO and LIBERE AUDIZIONI.
CONCORSO INTERNAZIONALE DI CANTO — already the European Community Competition for young opera singers; 81st edition.
Spoleto, Teatro Caio Melisso, 16–20 February 2027; bando and information available soon. Footer identifies Istituzione Teatro Lirico Sperimentale di Spoleto A. Belli.

items.reason: The page is directly linked from the institution's official Bandi e avvisi page, explicitly targets young opera singers, and carries the institution's legal identity in the footer.
limitations: The bando and detailed information are not yet available.
No application deadline, eligibility, fee, application route or official PDF can be verified yet.
